text.39858784fdf54c5fee1b: This combines independently estimated operating EV with disclosed market-valued financing claims. Employee claims remain incomplete. It is not a self-consistent intrinsic option valuation, complete equity appraisal or current October stock price.
text.337b78e09fd9f306ced0: . The targeted review verifies the cash, note, term-loan and capped-call references used below.
text.2d7836cf53768eb1ccb4: Conditional allocation for the unchanged selected operating case
text.9069bb34c86f69384396: The denominator keeps 88.6 common shares plus approximately 2.9 preferred common-equivalents. All note principal is cash-settled. No convertible shares or separate coupons are added under this fair-value method. The capped calls are equity-classified and absent from balance-sheet assets, so the dated asset proxy is credited once. Historical call premiums are already reflected in capital.
text.57d81d3a1d25f7752baa: The 757.8 cumulative requests through August 14 include 519.4 principal already cash-settled during FY2026. Neither 757.8 nor the 238.4 difference is an additional verified June liability. The original research files remain frozen; this versioned review supersedes that interpretation.
text.c30dfac9cfddd25712e2: The 6,052.9 adjustment is a disclosed note fair-value adjustment above principal, not a pure option valuation. It and the approximate 200 capped-call credit are independently editable. A no-call-recovery scenario removes the asset credit. The principal-only stress removes both the note adjustment and call credit; it is not a fair-value bound.
text.b621549b724b21303c9a: Every operating Monte Carlo trial uses the same selected dated claim inputs. Note and call values are not re-solved when operating EV changes. Thus an equity histogram remains conditional on fixed June financing proxies, not a jointly modeled equity/option distribution.
text.498f819dcbc1cde5c874: Fresh drafts use the reviewed values. Existing numerical edits and explicit blanks are retained. Older implicit blanks become explicit unknown note inputs, with their previously omitted call credit held at zero. “Load reviewed June bridge values” applies the two source values deliberately; Undo restores the full preceding draft. Loading the original operating case preserves claim settings.
text.e89715438242893a1759: Employee-award values, exact preferred equivalents, cash availability and a June-to-October cash/debt/share roll-forward remain unresolved. AAOI and NBIS remain operating-only. Their incomplete funding and ownership information is not turned into a per-share range.
